editorial_summary: Jacksonville's light boat parade on the St. Johns, run Thanksgiving Saturday and finished with a fireworks waterfall off a bridge. Watch the boats, then the bridge waterfall fireworks.
schedule_note: Saturday November 28, 2026 on the St. Johns River. Start time to be announced by the City. Free.
insider_tip: The Southbank Riverwalk gives you the parade and both bridges in one view; the Northbank fills first.

editorial_summary: Florida's only alpine snow park: snow tubing on Snowy Slopes, a 60 foot tall, 400 foot long hill, real snow play in the Arctic Igloo, ice skating on the Crystal Ribbon, Santa's Christmas Lane and the Alpine Village.
schedule_note: Seventh season opens November 14, 2026; ticketed dates posted through February 2027. Hours vary by day (opening night 10 AM to 11 PM).
insider_tip: Book online: every ticket is $6 more at the box office, and early slots start under $25 on opening weekend.

schedule_note: Select nights; closed Thanksgiving and Christmas Day; timed entry 6-7:30 or 7:30-9 PM, open until 10 PM
